Ahoo-Wang/wow-project-template.description: A DDD project template for quickly building projects based on the Wow framework.
Ahoo-Wang/wow-project-template.body:
# Wow Service Template

A DDD + Event Sourcing + CQRS service template organized according to the [Wow](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow) 10 best practices. Get it running, test it, and deploy it, then replace the sample domain with your own.

> **Warning**
>
> This template is based on **Wow 10.0.0-beta.22** (a pre-release version): the API, configuration, storage, and wire formats may still change before the 10.0.0 GA, no compatibility is promised, and it is not recommended for production use.

## Design Principles

1. **The template is a starting point.** Every file is either infrastructure you keep or a sample to be replaced. Each practice in the sample appears only once, and each one has tests.
2. **Follow Wow's conventions.** Module roles, the Gradle plugins, naming, the test DSL, and the deployment approach all match the Wow documentation; any deviations are explained.
3. **Minimal build.** Versions are declared once in [`gradle/libs.versions.toml`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/wow-project-template/blob/HEAD/gradle/libs.versions.toml), and build logic lives only in [`build-logic`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/wow-project-template/blob/HEAD/build-logic); only `blog-api`, which other services need, is published.
4. **Correctness is gated.** Compilation and KSP, domain and service tests, detekt, coverage, Manifest compatibility, integration tests against real storage, TS client drift, distribution smoke tests, and Helm values validation all run in CI.
5. **Production paths are explicit.** Storage (MongoDB), caller authentication (CoSec gateway), deployment (Wow's Helm chart), and observability (OpenTelemetry) each have a default answer; local development depends on no external services.

## Sample Domain: Blog

Authors write articles and submit them for review; editors approve or reject them; a review Saga coordinates the two aggregates; if a review is not decided before the timeout, it is automatically returned to the author.

秋笺 is an open-source desktop Markdown editor. Paste screenshots or draw Excalidraw hand-drawn diagrams, and the content is stored by default directly in the same `.md` file, with no image host to set up. Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars are stripped before validation
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecurity flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` is treated as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates before limits** — one node with different names no longer pushes out legitimate configs

coffin299/VRCast.description: An app that lets you use VRChat avatars in OBS and more, VSeeFace-style / An app that lets you handle VRChat avatars like VSeeFace in OBS and similar tools
coffin299/VRCast.body:
# VRCast

A lightweight standalone runtime that runs 3D avatars for VRChat in a form close to individual avatars, rather than requiring a full Unity project. It aims to display and track avatars easily, like VSeeFace, and output them to streaming software such as OBS.

```text
VRChat avatar (Unity / VCC project)          VRM avatar (VRoid, etc.)
        ↓  com.vrcast.converter (Editor-only package)      │
MyAvatar.vrcaster                                   MyAvatar.vrm (no conversion needed)
        ↓                                                │
VRCast.exe (Runtime)  ←──────────────────────────────────┘
        ↓
OBS (Window Capture / Game Capture / Spout2) / virtual camera (Discord / Zoom, etc.)
```

The design goal is that users do not need to keep the Unity Editor, VCC, or the VRChat project running at all times.

**In-app multilingual support**: English / 日本語 / 한국어 / 简体中文 / 繁體中文 (the default is "Auto", which matches the OS language; you can switch at any time with the button at the top of the screen)

- Website (overview and help; Japanese / English / Korean / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese. The default follows the browser language. Light / dark): <https://coffin299.github.io/VRCast/>
  (Source is on the [`webpage` branch](https://github.com/coffin299/VRCast/tree/webpage); the root of the branch is published via GitHub Pages)
- Official Discord (VRCast Community; for questions, feature requests, bug reports, etc.): <https://discord.gg/vM5RH52HdF>

## Current status

**Version 4.6.4 (release version)**. Changes are listed in [CHANGELOG.txt](https://github.com/coffin299/VRCast/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.txt) (Japanese / English; also included in the distribution zip).

prostoy23rus/zapret2wizard.description: ⚡ Automatic DPI bypass wizard: LuCI web interface for OpenWrt, Circular combinations, Discord VoiceFlow and turbo strategy selection
prostoy23rus/zapret2wizard.body:
# Zapret2Wizard

**DPI/TSPU bypass control on OpenWrt:** the `zapret2 (nfqws2)` engine, a Rust strategy scanner and a LuCI web interface in one package. Select candidates for your network, manage domains and verify the result, without installing apps on every device. System dependencies are installed separately with the package manager; after installation, regular traffic processing does not require access to GitHub.

---

## What this gives you

- **Configuration on the router, not on each device.** Processing of home network traffic for phones, laptops and TVs whose traffic passes through the router.
- **Search tailored to your network.** The Rust scanner tests candidate strategies; additional HTTP probes are run before applying. The result depends on the provider, the route and the selected services.
- **You choose the domains.** Separate lists for YouTube, Discord, Twitch, X and Instagram, custom domains and global exclusions.
- **Management in LuCI.** Checks, selection, lists, service status and history in the OpenWrt web interface.
- **Diagnostics instead of guesswork.** `doctor`, `selftest` and `class` help verify the environment, data transfer and network responses to different techniques.

wlrwx/football-engine.description: Sporttery Football Probability Analysis System - Dixon-Coles + Monte Carlo ensemble model, fully automated on GitHub Actions
wlrwx/football-engine.body:
# Sporttery Engine

Sporttery football probability analysis and virtual betting simulation system. Based on the Dixon-Coles Poisson model + Monte Carlo simulation, with market-probability-dominant fusion and Kelly criterion for virtual bet allocation. Runs fully automatically on GitHub Actions at zero server cost. **For data analysis and algorithm learning only. Does not constitute any betting advice; all outputs are virtual bookkeeping.**

## Core Principles (driven by 2026-08 empirical data)

1. **The market is the benchmark**: Based on ledger evidence from 426 matches, the pure market (de-vigged) Brier score of 0.583 outperforms any model stream (0.646+) → fusion weight is market-dominant (0.75), with models/third parties only fine-tuning
2. **All switches are decided by data**: Every step of the fusion chain is a config switch
   (`config/prediction.json["fusion"]["post_fusion"]`), and whether each is kept is decided by paired replay of settled ledgers via `scripts/ablation_replay.py`
3. **Self-evolution with guardrails**: Any automatic activation of the calibration layer / LGBM must pass a time-based split and a paired significance test; degradation automatically deactivates it — see `docs/UPGRADE2_20260829.md`

## Architecture

```
Daily loop: fetch data → fusion prediction (fusion.py, fully traced) → lock → settle → self-learning
Weekly loop: backtest → weight optimization (champion/challenger) → parameter refit → Monday health check
Evolution loop: clean samples (chain=v2) accumulate → calibration layer auto-revives/deactivates (calibration_auto)
                      → LGBM shadow training + validation (lgbm_shadow) → weekly effect assessment (tracker)
```

## Tech Stack

- Python 3.12 / numpy / scikit-learn / LightGBM / joblib
- GitHub Actions (computation) + GitHub Pages (reports)
- No database; pure CSV/JSON + git versioning; ledgers are append-only

# Cursor AI Downloads Tracker (Node.js)

This project is a download link tracker for Cursor AI, implemented in Node.js. It collects and maintains official download links for all versions of the Cursor AI editor and displays them in an organized manner in the README.md file.

## Features

- Automatically fetches latest download links for Cursor AI editor across different platforms (Windows, Mac, Linux) and architectures (x64, arm64, etc.)
- Maintains a history of download links for all versions
- Automatically updates the download link tables

## Usage

### Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### Compile

```bash
npm run build
```

### Run

```bash
npm start
```

Or

```bash
npm run update
```

## File Description

- `scripts/track-downloads.ts`: Main script responsible for fetching latest links and updating history
- `cursor-version-archive.json`: Stores download link history for all versions
- `README.md`: Contains tables of download links

## Cursor AI Download Links

Below are the official download links for various versions of Cursor AI, presented in multiple views for your convenience.
